paras.en: “People,” said the little prince, “bury themselves in express trains, but they no longer know what they are looking for. So they rush about and go round in circles...”
paras.zh: “人们啊，”小王子说，“他们钻进快车，却已经不知道自己在找什么了。于是他们忙忙乱乱，兜着圈子……”

paras.en: And he added:
paras.zh: 他又说：

paras.en: “It is not worth the trouble...”
paras.zh: “不值得这么费事……”

paras.en: The well we had reached did not look like the other wells in the Sahara. Wells in the Sahara are simply holes dug in the sand. This one looked like a village well. But there was no village there, and I thought I must be dreaming.
paras.zh: 我们走到的这口井，和撒哈拉沙漠里的其他井不一样。撒哈拉沙漠里的井，只是在沙地上挖出的洞。这一口却像村子里的井。可是这里没有任何村子，我以为自己在做梦。

paras.en: “It is strange,” I said to the little prince. “Everything is ready: the pulley, the bucket and the rope...”
paras.zh: “真奇怪，”我对小王子说，“一切都准备好了：滑轮、水桶，还有绳子……”

paras.en: He laughed, touched the rope and set the pulley moving. And the pulley groaned like an old weather vane when the wind has been asleep for a long time.
paras.zh: 他笑了，碰了碰绳子，让滑轮转动起来。滑轮发出呻吟，像风沉睡了很久以后，一只老旧的风向标发出的声音。

paras.en: “Can you hear?” said the little prince. “We are waking this well, and it is singing...”
paras.zh: “你听见了吗？”小王子说，“我们正在唤醒这口井，它在唱歌……”

paras.en: I did not want him to exert himself:
paras.zh: 我不想让他费力气：

paras.en: “Let me do it,” I told him. “It is too heavy for you.”
paras.zh: “让我来吧，”我对他说，“这对你来说太重了。”

paras.en: Slowly I hauled the bucket up to the rim of the well. I set it firmly upright there. The pulley’s song lingered in my ears, and in the water, which was still trembling, I saw the sun tremble.
paras.zh: 我慢慢把水桶提到井沿上，稳稳当当地放好。滑轮的歌声还在我耳边回响，水还在颤动，我看见水里的太阳也在颤动。

paras.en: “I am thirsty for that water,” said the little prince. “Give me some to drink…”
paras.zh: “我渴了，就想喝这水，”小王子说，“给我喝一点吧……”

paras.en: And I understood what he had been searching for!
paras.zh: 这时，我明白了他一直在寻找什么！

paras.en: I lifted the bucket to his lips. He drank with his eyes closed. It was sweet, like a celebration. This water was far more than nourishment. It was born of the walk beneath the stars, of the pulley’s song, of the effort of my arms. It was good for the heart, like a gift. When I was a little boy, the light of the Christmas tree, the music of midnight mass and the gentleness of smiles were what gave the Christmas present I received all its glow, in just the same way.
paras.zh: 我把水桶举到他唇边。他闭着眼睛喝了起来。那感觉甜美得像过节。这水远不只是滋养身体的东西。它诞生于群星下的行走，诞生于滑轮的歌声，诞生于我双臂的用力。它像一份礼物，滋润着心。当我还是个小男孩时，圣诞树的灯光、午夜弥撒的音乐、微笑里的温柔，也正是这样，让我收到的圣诞礼物焕发出全部的光彩。

paras.en: “People where you live,” said the little prince, “grow five thousand roses in a single garden… and they do not find what they are searching for there…”
paras.zh: “你那儿的人们，”小王子说，“在同一个花园里种五千朵玫瑰……却在里面找不到他们寻找的东西……”

paras.en: “They do not find it,” I replied…
paras.zh: “他们找不到，”我回答……

paras.en: “And yet what they are searching for could be found in a single rose or a little water…”
paras.zh: “可他们寻找的东西，也许在一朵玫瑰或一点水里就能找到……”

paras.en: “Of course,” I replied.
paras.zh: “当然，”我回答。

paras.en: And the little prince added:
paras.zh: 小王子又说：

paras.en: “But eyes are blind. You must search with your heart.”
paras.zh: “可是眼睛是盲目的。得用心去寻找。”

paras.en: I had drunk. I was breathing easily. At daybreak, the sand is the colour of honey. That honey colour made me happy too. Why did I have to feel sad…
paras.zh: 我已经喝过水了。呼吸也舒畅了。天刚亮时，沙子是蜂蜜的颜色。这蜂蜜般的颜色，也让我感到幸福。为什么我偏偏还要难过呢……

paras.en: “You must keep your promise,” the little prince said softly to me. He had sat down beside me again.
paras.zh: 小王子已经又在我身旁坐下，轻声对我说：“你得遵守你的诺言。”

paras.en: “What promise?”
paras.zh: “什么诺言？”

paras.en: “You know… a muzzle for my sheep… I am responsible for that flower!”
paras.zh: “你知道的……给我的羊一个嘴套……我对那朵花有责任！”

paras.en: I took my rough drawings out of my pocket. The little prince caught sight of them and said with a laugh:
paras.zh: 我从口袋里拿出我的绘画草稿。小王子看见了，笑着说：

paras.en: “Your baobabs, they look a little like cabbages…”
paras.zh: “你画的猴面包树，有点像卷心菜……”

paras.en: “Oh!”
And I had been so proud of those baobabs!
paras.zh: 亏我还为那些猴面包树那么自豪呢！

paras.en: “Your fox… his ears… they look a little like horns… and they are too long!”
paras.zh: “你画的狐狸……它的耳朵……有点像角……而且太长了！”

paras.en: And he laughed again.
paras.zh: 他又笑了起来。

paras.en: “You are being unfair, little fellow. I only knew how to draw closed boa constrictors and open boa constrictors.”
paras.zh: “你这样说不公平，小家伙。我那时只会画合着的蟒蛇和打开的蟒蛇，别的什么也不会画。”

paras.en: “Oh! That will do,” he said. “Children know.”
paras.zh: “哦！这样就行了，”他说，“孩子们懂的。”

paras.en: So I sketched a muzzle in pencil. And my heart tightened as I gave it to him:
paras.zh: 于是我用铅笔画了一个嘴套。把它交给他时，我心里一阵发紧：

paras.en: “You have plans I know nothing about...”
paras.zh: “你有些打算，是我不知道的……”

paras.en: But he did not answer me. He said to me:
paras.zh: 可他没有回答我。他对我说：

paras.en: “You know, my fall to Earth... tomorrow will be the anniversary...”
paras.zh: “你知道，我掉到地球上……明天就是周年纪念日了……”

paras.en: Then, after a silence, he spoke again:
paras.zh: 接着，沉默了一会儿，他又说：

paras.en: “I fell very near here...”
paras.zh: “我当时就掉在离这里很近的地方……”

paras.en: And he blushed.
paras.zh: 他的脸红了。

paras.en: And once again, without knowing why, I felt a strange sadness. Yet a question came to me:
paras.zh: 我又感到一阵奇怪的悲伤，却不明白为什么。不过，一个问题浮上心头：

paras.en: “So it was not by chance that, on the morning I met you eight days ago, you were walking about like that, all alone, a thousand miles from anywhere people lived! Were you heading back towards the place where you fell?”
paras.zh: “那么，八天前我认识你的那个早晨，你就那样独自走着，离所有有人居住的地方都有一千英里，这并不是偶然的！你那时是在往你掉下来的地方走回去吗？”

paras.en: The little prince blushed again.
paras.zh: 小王子的脸又红了。

paras.en: And I added, hesitantly:
paras.zh: 我又迟疑着补了一句：

paras.en: “Because of the anniversary, perhaps?…”
paras.zh: “也许是因为那个周年纪念日？……”

paras.en: The little prince blushed once more. He never answered questions, but when someone blushes, it means “yes”, doesn't it?
paras.zh: 小王子的脸再一次红了。他从来不回答问题，可是，一个人脸红，就表示“是的”，不是吗？

paras.en: “Ah!” I said to him. “I'm afraid…”
paras.zh: “啊！”我对他说，“我害怕……”

paras.en: But he replied:
paras.zh: 可他回答我：

paras.en: “You must work now. You must go back to your machine. I'll wait for you here. Come back tomorrow evening…”
paras.zh: “你现在得去干活了。你得回到你的飞机那里去。我在这里等你。明天晚上再来……”

paras.en: But I was not reassured. I remembered the fox. You may cry a little if you have let yourself be tamed…
paras.zh: 可我还是不放心。我想起了狐狸。要是让自己被驯服了，就可能要流一点眼泪……
